<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductPrototype" name="Product idea and prototype evaluation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" name="Idea for a new product or improvement identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Research</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResearchFeasibility" name="R&D team conducts initial research and feasibility studies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Research</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Research_Concepts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftConcepts" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Research_Concepts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Concepts_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select a promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Concepts_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype functionality, safety, and market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Feedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect testing feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Feedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Is refinement needed?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefinementNeeded_Refine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoRefinement_Disposition</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefinementNeeded_Refine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrototypeDisposition" name="Prototype disposition" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoRefinement_Disposition</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disposition_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disposition_Discarded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Prototype approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disposition_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Prototype discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disposition_Discarded</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Research" sourceRef="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" targetRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Research_Concepts" sourceRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility" targetRef="Task_DraftConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Concepts_Select" sourceRef="Task_DraftConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Build" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementNeeded_Refine" name="Yes — refinement needed" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_Test" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement_Disposition" name="No — refinement not needed" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_PrototypeDisposition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disposition_Approved" name="Approved for further development" sourceRef="Gateway_PrototypeDisposition" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disposition_Discarded" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_PrototypeDisposition" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
